summary: Update one field on an existing record.
purpose: Use this when you need a reviewed server-side starter for changing one field on one record.
learningGoals: Understand that update operations are side-effecting and must stay code-only in the playground.
Compare the direct Data API helper with the OData payload pattern.
Practice reviewing both the target record and the target field before execution.
explanation: Edit is intentionally not runnable from the beginner testing surface. It still teaches the request shape so users can move into controlled server-side work safely.
commonMistakes: Updating the wrong record because the record ID or key was copied incorrectly.
Assuming the same payload can be posted from the browser safely.
Changing field names instead of preserving the real FileMaker schema.
expectedResult: You get server-side starter code for an update request that is ready for review but not auto-execution.

safety.confirmationText: Updating records changes data. Review the identifier, field name, and environment before running this code.

prerequisites: Confirm the record identifier in a disposable environment first.
Review the exact FileMaker field name before running the update.

inputs.label: Layout or table
inputs.help: Needed for the OData variant and useful context for reviewers.

inputs.label: Record ID or key
inputs.help: For Data API this is typically the FileMaker record ID. For OData it is the table key or ROWID.

inputs.label: Field name
inputs.help: Use the exact FileMaker field name to update.

inputs.label: New value
inputs.help: Use the value you want written into the target field.

javascript:data-api.reason: Browser playground testing is intentionally read-only. Generate the PHP version and review it server-side before updating records.

javascript:odata.reason: Browser playground testing is intentionally read-only. Generate the PHP version and review the protected OData route before updating records.

beginner: Edit changes existing data, so this module only generates code for review.
Double-check the record ID or key before you run anything server-side.
Keep the FileMaker field name exactly as it exists in the schema.
advanced: The OData starter remains payload-only to preserve the legacy generator behavior.
Unsafe JavaScript combinations are explicit so the UI can teach rather than imply support.
This module is suitable for fixture validation but not for live browser execution.
